appearance_facts.fact: The title 'Incidence of Condition A in US States' is printed in large black text at the top of the map.
A vertical color bar labeled 'Low' at the bottom and 'High' at the top, with values ranging from 0 to 100, is positioned to the right of the map.
The state of Mississippi (MS) is colored dark red, indicating the highest incidence value on the map.
The state of Missouri (MO) is colored light yellow, indicating a low incidence value on the map.
The state of Delaware (DE) is colored orange, indicating a medium incidence value on the map.
Several states including Montana (MT), Idaho (ID), Wyoming (WY), Nevada (NV), and Oregon (OR) are colored dark red, indicating high incidence.
The state of Georgia (GA) is colored dark red, indicating high incidence.
The state of South Carolina (SC) is colored dark red, indicating high incidence.

public_definitions: The task requires selecting the state with the highest incidence from the dashboard to route into the highest-incidence priority follow-up workflow.
The dashboard is the only source for selecting the state to route.
The state incidence record to open must be the one corresponding to the state with the highest incidence value as shown on the dashboard.
